mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT -- t.* 대신 필요한 모든 컬럼을 명시 (명확성) t.class_number, t.class_name, t.class_description, t.class_image, t.user_number, t.class_category_number, t.start_date, t.end_date, t.is_daily, t.duration_weeks, t.class_time,
ST_AsText(t.location) AS location, c.class_category_name AS categoryName
FROM tb_class t -- 1. 메인 카테고리는 항상 조인 JOIN tb_class_category c ON t.class_category_number = c.class_category_number
JOIN tb_class_keyword tk ON t.class_number = tk.class_number JOIN tb_detail_keyword dk ON tk.keyword_number = dk.keyword_number
WHERE 1=1
AND c.class_category_name = #{categoryName}
AND dk.keyword_name = #{detailKeywordName}
AND ( t.class_name LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY t.class_number DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_class ( class_name, class_description, user_number, class_category_number, start_date, end_date, class_time, location ) VALUES ( #{className}, #{classDescription}, #{userNumber}, #{classCategoryNumber}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{classTime}, -- WKT 문자열을 PostGIS Point 객체로 변환. TypeHandler의 JavaType을 명시하는 것이 안정적. ST_GeomFromText(#{location, javaType=org.locationtech.jts.geom.Point, typeHandler=com.yourpackage.handler.JtsPointTypeHandler}, 4326) )
mapper.select: SELECT keyword_number FROM tb_detail_keyword WHERE keyword_name = #{keywordName}
